Labels, SmPC and two functional studies say partial agonist at alpha4beta2 (45% of nicotine's maximum, Rollema; 13.4% of acetylcholine's, Mihalak). Disagreement recorded: GtoPdb codes type and action 'Agonist' (its efficacy-unstated value; its free text says 'mild agonistic activity'), and the Tyrvaya Highlights say 'cholinergic agonist', the probable origin of ChEMBL mec 1045 on the tartrate CHEMBL6067972 (its cited DailyMed setid 27c6abf0 is 404). Applies equally to CHRNA4 and CHRNB2: the target is the heteromer; GtoPdb files the row under the alpha4 subunit only but states 'the interaction is with the α4β2 heteromer'. Papers read as abstracts only.
